Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk | Bond markets have priced in nearly four rate hikes. Where should investors invest now?
Markets.summary: Piyush Barawal of WhiteOak Capital notes that bond markets have already priced in nearly four interest rate hikes. He suggests that the two- to four-year segment of the yield curve presents an attractive investment opportunity.

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk | Gold for ballast, silver for growth; avoid industrial commodities in core portfolios: Saish Sawant
Markets.summary: Emkay Global analyst Saish Sawant recommends using gold as portfolio ballast and silver for growth while avoiding industrial commodities in core holdings. He shares this advice while breaking down the contrasting market movements of gold, crude oil, and copper.

Markets.title: Oil Price Today (November 3): Crude oil rebounds to $105 as fresh attacks outweigh peace talks. What are experts saying?
Markets.summary: Crude oil prices rose to $105 per barrel following a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, which heightened Middle East conflict concerns. Goldman Sachs subsequently revised its oil price forecasts upward to a potential $140 per barrel despite ongoing peace talks between Tehran and the US.

Markets.title: Dividend alert! Last day to buy Asian Paints, Coal India and 6 more stocks for dividend payout worth nearly Rs 31. Do you own any?
Markets.summary: Investors must buy shares of Asian Paints, Coal India, and six other stocks by today to qualify for upcoming dividend payouts totaling nearly Rs 31. Under India's T+1 settlement cycle, purchasing stocks at least one trading day before the record date ensures they are credited to demat accounts in time for corporate actions.

Markets.title: Bonus issue alert! Last day to buy this Rakesh Jhunjhunwala-backed smallcap pharma stock for 1:1 bonus bonanza
Markets.summary: Today is the final day to purchase shares of this Rakesh Jhunjhunwala-backed smallcap pharma company to qualify for its 1:1 bonus issue. Under the T+1 settlement cycle, investors must buy the stock at least one day before the record date to receive the bonus shares in their demat accounts.

Markets.title: Gold price prediction: Will gold extend gains on Tuesday? Check outlook for November 3
Markets.summary: Investors are monitoring the upcoming US midterm elections to gauge potential shifts in the country's fiscal policy and broader market sentiment. This political focus is driving market interest in whether gold prices will extend their gains on Tuesday, November 3.

Geo-Political.title: US strikes Iran ahead of midterm elections
Geo-Political.summary: US officials stated that military strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island were limited and defensive actions. The attacks occurred shortly before the US midterm elections.

Geo-Political.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump's request to stop California counting disputed votes
Geo-Political.summary: The Supreme Court rejected the Trump administration's request to stop California from counting disputed ballots just before the midterm elections. This ruling effectively ends the administration's legal effort to disqualify those votes.

Geo-Political.summary: Russian aerial bombs struck a Ukrainian aid center, killing 26 people in a southern village. Ukrainian officials condemned the strike as an utterly horrific attack.

Geo-Political.summary: Thousands of European troops will rehearse a deployment to Ukraine in preparation for a potential peace scenario. Western officials emphasized that these forces would not participate in any offensive operations.

Geo-Political.title: Plane may have broken apart ahead of deadly Florida jet crash, say investigators
Geo-Political.summary: Investigators report that a plane may have broken apart before crashing in Florida, resulting in fatalities. The National Transportation Safety Board also suspects weather was a factor, though the exact cause remains undetermined.

Geo-Political.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
Geo-Political.summary: A cyber-attack targeted shop freezers in seven European countries, causing their temperatures to rise as high as 50 degrees Celsius. This malicious disruption affected retail stores across multiple nations in the region.

Data & Insights.title: How policy needs to catch up with India’s upcoming demographic reset
Data & Insights.summary: India's population is aging, and policymakers must understand these gradual demographic changes now. Updating policy priorities today is essential to prepare for the country's future demographic shift.

Data & Insights.title: India’s manufacturing growth stays strong as price pressures ease: PMI Manufacturing survey
Data & Insights.summary: India's manufacturing growth remained strong in October despite the purchasing managers' index falling slightly to 54.7 from 55.1 in September. The index stayed comfortably above the neutral mark of 50 and its long-run average as price pressures eased.

Data & Insights.title: Why India faces three balancing acts—and why they are tough to achieve
Data & Insights.summary: India must manage three difficult economic trade-offs involving fuel prices, interest rates, and tax incentives. Achieving these balances is tough because policymakers must weigh competing priorities like household savings, foreign investment, and fiscal stability.

Data & Insights.title: India's festive demand is uneven as inflation, price hikes weigh on shoppers
Data & Insights.summary: While overall consumer demand in India remains resilient, inflation driven by the West Asia war is causing noticeable stress in specific retail categories. Price hikes and cost pressures are weighing on shoppers during the festive season, leading to uneven purchasing patterns.

Data & Insights.title: Imports, low base power fastest GST growth in four years in October
Data & Insights.summary: India's GST collections grew 23% year-on-year in October, marking the fourth month this fiscal year that revenues exceeded ₹2 trillion. This rapid growth was driven by a surge in import-related taxes and a low statistical base from the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: States get addition instalment of tax devolution of  ₹1.09 lakh crore, supported by strong economy, taxes—See break-up
Data & Insights.summary: The central government has released an additional tax devolution installment of ₹1.09 lakh crore to states. Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that this release was enabled by strong economic activity and buoyant tax collections.

India.title: Indian Navy Rescues 20 Crew Members From Pirated Vessel Azini In 48-Hour Op
India.summary: The Indian Navy rescued 20 crew members from the pirated vessel Azini during a 48-hour operation on November 2. The mission successfully secured the safe release of all crew members from heavily armed pirates.

India.title: Assam Cop Who Arrested ISIS's India Head Wins Home Ministry's Top Award
India.summary: Assam Police officer Partha Sarathi Mahanta has won a top Ministry of Home Affairs award for his counter-extremism and anti-drug operations. Since March 2023, he has successfully overseen multiple missions, including the arrest of the India head of ISIS.

India.title: UP Government Sets Up 3-Tier System To Address Medical Students' Grievances
India.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has established a three-tier system to address grievances from medical students. Under this initiative, a student grievance and voice box will be installed on the campus of every medical college in the state.

India.title: Uttar Pradesh Preliminary Eligibility Test Provisional Answer Key Released, Check Here
India.summary: UPSSSC has released the provisional answer key for the PET 2026 exam. Candidates who took the test on October 25, 30, and November 1 can now check it online.

India.title: Bihar Board 2027 Announces November Sent-Up Exam Schedule For Class 10, 12
India.summary: The Bihar Board has announced the November sent-up exam schedule for Class 10 and Class 12 students appearing for the 2027 examinations. The board also released the dates for the corresponding practical exams.

India.title: CBSE LOC Correction Window 2026-27 Opens For Class 10, 12; Last Date November 4
India.summary: The CBSE has opened the correction window for the Class 10 and 12 LOC for the 2026-27 academic year until November 4. There is no separate fee for making corrections, though late submission fees apply after the deadline.
